title: Cards and Worlds
subtitle: Every card is one world
text:
A blank Jump Card makes a random world the first time it is used. After that the card is bound to that world for good and always goes back to it.

Program a blank card at a Research Station to choose its world type or add ores and mobs you have researched. A bound card cannot be programmed.

Nether and End Cards open to the Nether and the End.

Story Cards come from quests. They lead to a world with an objective. Collect it to finish the story. If you come back without it, the next jump makes a fresh world to try again.
